pages.text: ScalingMobs and Champions Unofficial create the dimension-based difficulty scaling that defines IridescentCraft's threat progression.

$(bold)ScalingMobs:$(/bold) Applies per-dimension multipliers to mob HP, damage, speed, and armor. These are not flat increases — they are dimension-specific tuning. A T3 Nether blaze is categorically harder than a T1 Overworld blaze.$(br2)$(bold)Champions:$(/bold) ~8% of all mobs are Champions (elite variants). Higher rates in harder dimensions. Champion rank determines affix count (1–4).

$(bold)Improved Mobs:$(/bold) Uses PLAYERMEAN mode — mob stats scale to the average player's gear level. On a server, this prevents one endgame player from making the world trivial for new players.$(br2)$(bold)Dynamic Difficulty:$(/bold) Scales over time and per-dimension based on how long players have spent there. A base you've lived in for days is more dangerous than one you just entered.

$(bold)No book.$(/bold) Scaling Mobs and Champions Unofficial are configured specifically for this pack — see the $(bold)Systems$(/bold) chapter for how difficulty scaling and Champion affixes work in IridescentCraft.
